correctness.rationale: Exact involution and primary-strip angular lift give \(I=\pmho\); cubic \(4t(1-t^2)\) proves exhaustive 0/2/4 cycle count. Verified return determinant \(q^2\) and trace \(1+q^2+k^2-2\gamma k\) yield Schur sink criterion \(0<k<2\gamma\). Strict monotonicity gives one loss per positive-derivative branch, and an exact positive ratio proves the losses strictly ordered. A packaged checker establishes symbolic identities and 48 finite orbit checks; these are not substituted for the global proof.

value.rationale: Exact classification of a natural symmetric half-turn resonance in the same two-harmonic map used for multistability and periodic-window studies. Two simultaneously born sinks provably lose stability at distinct explicit parameters, separating robust bistability, monostability, and absence of sinks in this class. The sign and strict ordering require the cubic forcing shape and full two-step linearization, not a textbook local stability calculation.
